=== TypeNode / number shapes that still map to Type::Generic ===

From convert_type (Codama TypeNode):
- Map (mapTypeNode) — associative key/value; not a positional Borsh scalar field layout we model. Opaque by design; kind equality still catches map↔other renames.
- Set (setTypeNode) — same rationale as Map.
- Tuple (tupleTypeNode) — inline tuple-as-field has no Defined name without inventing synthetic ids. Top-level account/definedTypes structs are promoted to TypeDef separately. Known gap for rare inline tuples; Vixen fixtures typically Link definedTypes.
- Struct (structTypeNode) — same as Tuple for inline struct-as-field; account/definedTypes promotion path is separate. Known gap if Codama embeds anonymous structs in fields.
- Enum (enumTypeNode) — same as Struct for inline enum-as-field; definedTypes enums go through convert_defined_type. Known gap for anonymous inline enums.

From number_format (NumberFormat, not TypeNode variants):
- F32 / F64 / ShortU16 — not standard Anchor/Borsh integer scalars in our Type enum. Opaque by design.

No catch-all remains: convert_type is exhaustive over TypeNode.

=== What was added ===
- Hidden CLI: `idl-drift inspect <IDL.json>` (exit 0=fully mapped, 1=any reachable Generic, 2=io/parse)
- fixtures/real/README.md — how to drop Vixen Codama IDLs (tests/idls/*.json) or produce via codama
- scripts/inspect-real.sh — batch inspect; final "N/M real IDLs fully mapped"
- src/inspect.rs — coverage walk over ix args + reachable type fields
- convert_type — explicit Map/Set/Tuple/Struct/Enum arms with comments (no invented layout mappings)

diff.rs classification logic unchanged (only made reachable_types pub).
